location_description:
New Berlin () is a city located along the Milwaukee/Waukesha County Border in the U.S. State of Wisconsin. The population was 40,451 at the 2020  census, making it the third-largest community in Waukesha County after the cities of Waukesha and Brookfield.


== Pronunciation ==
Area residents put the accent on the first syllable of Berlin , rather than the second.
